title: Magma Walker
description: Magma Walker for Fabric adds a boot enchantment for permanent lava traversal by converting it into Magma Blocks
body:
Magma Walker is a utility mod for Fabric that grants players total freedom while exploring the Nether. It introduces a unique enchantment compatible with all types of footwear, ranging from simple Leather Boots to powerful Netherite armor.

Key Features:

Universal Compatibility: The Magma Walker enchantment can be applied to any boots in the game, including Leather, Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite.

Permanent Lava Traversal: Walk directly across lava oceans as the mod dynamically converts lava source blocks into solid Magma Blocks under your feet.

Tiered Levels: Features multiple enchantment ranks, such as Magma Walker II, to provide a more stable and wider path while moving.

Lightweight & Efficient: Optimized for the Fabric loader using Mixins, ensuring high performance and compatibility with your existing modpack.
